arguments.assumptions: FY2026 (53 weeks) GAAP diluted-EPS scenarios, using a split-adjusted price basis. FY2026 has ended but Q4 results were scheduled for September 30, so these are provisional historical-period estimates, not forward annual earnings. Anchor: reported first-nine-month FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS is $41.40. Q4 GAAP EPS guidance is $30.73 ± $1.00. Constant diluted-share approximation: bear $70.50 requires $29.10 residual EPS, below guidance's low end, representing weaker memory demand/pricing or lower earnings conversion; base $72.50 requires $31.10, within the stated guidance range, representing broadly delivered Q4 outlook; bull $74.00 requires $32.60, above guidance's high end, representing stronger AI-memory demand/pricing and conversion. P/E inputs of 10x/14x/18x are hypothetical stress assumptions, not observed multiples, consensus, normal/fair values or probabilities.

cases.rationale: Hypothetical Q4 GAAP EPS miss below management's guided range from weaker memory demand/pricing or lower earnings conversion.
Hypothetical broadly delivered Q4 GAAP EPS within management's guided range, with AI-memory demand and margins holding.
Hypothetical Q4 GAAP EPS beat above management's guided range from stronger AI-memory demand/pricing and earnings conversion.
